source: test-harness: skript-load-benchmark, neoskript-load-benchmark, event-benchmark, tick-benchmark and variable-benchmark, paper-26.3

startup.note: as each plugin logs its own startup load

reload.note: median wall time of /sk reload scripts, measured by the harness

events.note: microseconds per event, the median of 8 rounds of 20,000 after 4 to warm up

rows.workload: a loop with arithmetic and a local list

ticks.note: milliseconds per tick with 20 bots online and tick-benchmark.sk running, the median of 8 readings of the server's mean over 100 ticks; the script's part is over the same server with no scripts

variables.note: loading the same variables.csv when the server starts, the median of 3; Skript logs tenths of a second
